entries.035af94bb992269b: This business makes and sells magnetic heads and suspensions for hard disk drives (HDDs), as well as magnets. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥262,903 million, accounting for 10.5% of the total. Segment profit for the same year was ¥26,951 million. The company explains that sales volume for HDD magnetic heads for data center nearline HDDs increased by about 14%, and for HDD suspensions by about 35%, resulting in a substantial increase in revenue and profit. The main companies include the company itself, SAE Magnetics (H.K.) Ltd., Magnecomp Precision Technology Public Co., Ltd., Headway Technologies, Inc., TDK Philippines Corporation, and Acrathon Precision Technologies (HK) Ltd., and including the company, 16 companies belong to it.
entries.1ef3616d4224e82b: This business makes and sells temperature and pressure sensors, magnetic sensors and MEMS sensors. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥224,623 million, accounting for 9.0% of the total. Segment profit for the same year was ¥20,748 million. The company explains that sales of magnetic sensors increased for smartphone and automotive applications, MEMS sensors for microphones increased for the ICT market, and motion sensors increased for industrial equipment. The main companies include the company itself, InvenSense, Inc., and TDK-Micronas GmbH, and including the company, 16 companies belong to it.

entries.265340b4575de8c4: This business manufactures and sells secondary batteries (rechargeable batteries that can be used repeatedly) and power supplies. The main products are small batteries for smartphones, medium-sized batteries for industrial equipment, and power supplies for industrial equipment. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,370,304 million, accounting for 54.7% of the total for the 4 reportable segments and other, making it the largest business. Segment profit for the same fiscal year was ¥246,682 million. The company explains that small batteries rose on sales effects of new models, medium-sized batteries increased for the industrial equipment market, and power supplies also rose amid a gradual recovery in demand, resulting in higher revenue and profit. The main companies are the company itself, along with Amperex Technology Limited, Navitasys Technology Limited, Xiamen Ampeak Technology Limited, Navitasys India Private Limited, TDK (Malaysia) Sdn. Bhd. and others, totaling 33 companies including the company.
entries.278e777d1dcaf8e8: It consists of ceramic capacitors, aluminum electrolytic capacitors and film capacitors.
